📦 **meadow-med1214-gallery `5c750da`** — art(goods): Mediterranean olives, olive oil, raw silk and silk cloth

Four transparent 128px pixel icons, white masters and transparent generation originals, plus a 128px/32px light/dark overview and gallery card. Preserve Sirius batch 3 clay/glass rendering references and original author credits.

Alpha is binary, subject maximum edge is104px. Gallery build/check passed, and homepage, section search, card and enlarged image were inspected in browser. Blocksail native trade UI loaded all seven resource icons; buying olives updated stock, funds and weighted purchase cost.
